# WIDA jiangly 07C source

Exact unchanged GPL-3.0 source from hh2048/XCPC tree cfdb12db6792eb2303798541fb5c760ed2bc618b, path `03 - jiangly模板收集/04 - 数据结构/07C - Splay.cpp`, blob 5d646b4a210460e8095ca32143a96a01cc336c7e. Attribution: jiangly, original submission267199687 (2024-06-24), linked mirror https://cf.dianhsu.com/gym/105229/submission/267199687?version=1.5.

The source's functions and expressions are unmodified. Tests initialize a fixed rooted tree externally and compare point updates with independent enumeration of all unordered vertex paths, including singleton paths. Full original contest protocol is still unavailable. A separate large branch probe checks signed-int intermediate multiplication in virtual-child pair counts; this does not assert a bug within the original problem's unknown constraints.
